PhD Candidate in Economics, University of Oslo\
knut.heimdal (at) gmail.com · [knutheimdal.no](https://knutheimdal.no)

## Position

**PhD Research Fellow, Department of Economics, University of Oslo**, 2021–present. Research on fiscal policy, wage formation, and fertility using Norwegian registry data. Advisor: Martin Blomhoff Holm. Expected PhD completion: autumn 2027 (position extended by parental leave).

## Education

**MA in Economics**, University of Oslo, 2017–2019. Coursework in public economics, monetary policy, statistics, and the PhD course in applied microeconometrics. Thesis on the employment effects of chatbots.

**BA in International Studies**, University of Oslo, 2013–2017. Specialization in economics; thesis on Bitcoin and monetary theory.

**Exchange year, Freie Universität Berlin**, 2014–2015. Economics and international relations, taught mainly in German.

## Research in progress

**Field of Study and Fertility.** The causal effect of field of study on women's fertility timing, identified from admission cutoffs in Norway's centralized university admission system.

**Permanent Local Fiscal Multipliers** (with Amund H. Kordt and Martin B. Holm). Local government spending multipliers estimated from municipal fiscal shocks in Norwegian administrative data.

**Wage Determination and Coordination** (with Amund H. Kordt). The role of coordination in wage setting for aggregate outcomes; a minimal model tested on Norwegian and OECD data.

## Professional experience

**Adviser, Norwegian Ministry of Finance**, 2019–2021. National budget work in the Budget Department, covering the portfolio of the Ministry of Education and Research; drafted and presented the ministry's assessments of budget proposals for government deliberation.

**Student engagement, Monetary Policy Department, Norges Bank**, 2017–2019 (part-time). Contributed to the Monetary Policy Report in the unit for analysis and forecasting of the Norwegian economy.

**Coordinator and speaker, Confederation of Norwegian Enterprise (NHO)**, 2015–2017 (part-time). Delivered NHO's educational programmes on Norwegian business and Norway's relationship with the EU.

**Journalist**, Vårt Land (2017, politics and world desk) and Universitas (2016–2017, news).

## Teaching

**University of Oslo.** Master's level: macroeconomics and monetary policy (primary assignments), econometrics, labor economics, and corporate governance, 2021–present. Bachelor's level: seminar leader in Macroeconomic Analysis, 2017.

## Service

Board member, Department of Economics, University of Oslo, representing temporary academic staff, 2023–2027.

## Languages

Norwegian (native) · English (fluent) · German (proficient)
